author: corporaljoe
body: I remember playing on the good ol' terrascape.tk   Now I see the server has no survival or anything. It took me a bit to track this name down ;( wasn't worth it. After over 2-3 years at least I have returned.

Terrascape ended in like 2011 or 2012.

I do remember you, if you are you! Care to name any names that come to mind from Terrascape?

You'll find a couple around here and there:
